Definition
[shrinking breather definition] Source: kleiner-lott 1. Definition 12.17\group Kleiner–Lott Entropy Functionals A shrinking breather is a Ricci flow on $[t_1,t_2]$ with $g(t_2)=c\phi ^*g(t_1)$ for $c<1$ and $\phi \in \Diff (M)$.
